subject: Fitting simulated datasets into same model

messages.author: 87db6da4a9a8d291
messages.subject: Fitting simulated datasets into same model
parts:
Dear INLA experts,

I have created 100 simulated datasets and wanted to fit them individually using a simple ICAR model, to get 100 DIC and WAIC values. Could anyone help me with that? I appreciate any hints and suggestions. Best, Vicky

Here is my code 
formula2.ms <- Y~1+f(re_s, model = "besag", graph = gms,
                          scale.model = TRUE)

icar.ms <- inla(formula2.ms, family = "gaussian", data =icemss,
             control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
             control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE))

summary(icar.ms)
